response: According to the provided context from the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), joint controllers are two or more controllers who jointly determine the purposes and means of processing personal data. They are obligated to determine their respective responsibilities for compliance with the obligations under this regulation, including the exercise of the rights of the data subject and their duties to provide the information required in Articles 13 and 14. The arrangement between them should reflect the respective roles and relationships of the joint controllers vis-à-vis the data subjects, and the essence of the arrangement should be made available to the data subject.
